notes.title: Update

tags.bug: - previous locations is now correctly shown on map;

notes.title: On the way to Release

tags.bug: performance issues fix, reduced video memory fragmentation;

tags.feature: by popular demand, a compass has been added;

notes.title: New gameplay, New visual style, Map editor

tags.feature: - Changed gameplay process, old version is still available in settings menu;
- Added map editor for editing building parameters such as type, height and color;
- Optimized geodata format. Depending on territory, it can save up to 20% of disk space. This change will be applied on next geodata update.
- Added automatically shown street names (this feature can be disabled in settings menu);

tags.bug: - Fixed unability to use SSAO shadows.

notes.title: Update

tags.bug: [*] Fixed jerky physics movements (experimental, please use [b][i]--physics-step-v1[/i][/b] launch option to revert this change);
[*] Fixed mouse sensivity option applied only after restart;
[*] Fixed unability to operate the map on extremely high frame rates (>1000 fps), usually happen because of VSync turned off.

notes.title: Update

tags.bug: - Fixed 'frozen frame from last game' when starting a new game;
- Fixed huge performance drop after a long flight;
- Number of enemies is now limited in order to reduce performance issues;

tags.feature: - Tagged roofs is now rendered as a cone/pyramid; OSM tag 'roof:shape' is not used yet, other roof shapes and parameters will be implemented in further updates;

tags.bug: - Road lanes count is now limited to prevent possible errors on the map;
- Vertical position of the bridges is now calculated more precisely.

tags.feature: - Added auto-pause on Alt+Tab and on any other cases when window loses focus;
- Data downloader is now utilizes libcurl for HTTPS support.
